DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 麺の量についてご相談なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss the amount of noodles?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あまり多く食べられません。少ない量で頼めるか、料理の内容を先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 多く食べられず少量注文と料理内容を先に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't eat very much. Before ordering, I'd like to ask whether I can have a smaller portion and what's in the dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you can't eat much and want to check small-portion ordering and the dish's contents first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 選べる量は、この学習用メニューで確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the portion options on this menu for the learning exercise.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この小さい文字は麺だけの量ですか。スープや具の量も変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示が麺のみの量かスープと具も変わるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Does this small print refer only to the amount of noodles? Do the soup and toppings change too?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the quantity shown is only for noodles or whether the soup and toppings change too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 何が変わるかは担当者が確認してご説明します。ご希望は麺を少なくすることですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check what changes and explain. Is reducing the noodles what you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 麺を少なくしたいです。具は今の内容を見てから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 減らしたいのは麺で具は内容確認後に決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like fewer noodles. I'll decide about the toppings after seeing what's included now.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to reduce the noodles and will decide about toppings after checking the contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 具の内容も確認しましょう。足りなかった場合の追加についてもお聞きになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the toppings too. Would you also like to ask about adding more if it's not enough?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少量で頼んで、あとから麺を追加できるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 少量を頼んだ後で麺を追加できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to order a small portion and know whether I can add more noodles afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can add noodles after ordering a small portion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 追加できるものと注文方法は担当者へ確認します。今はまだ注文を確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll ask the person in charge what can be added and how to order it. Your order hasn't been finalized yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 量と追加の説明を聞いてから注文します。料理名だけでは判断できないので助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 量と追加方法の説明を聞いてから注文すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll order after hearing the explanation of portions and additions. I can't judge just from the dish's name, so that helps.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will order after hearing the explanation of portions and how to add more. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認した内容をもとにお選びください。注文が決まりましたらお声がけください。ごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please choose based on the checked information. Let us know when you've decided your order. Take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文前の材料確認をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check the ingredients before ordering?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小麦にアレルギーがあります。この料理のたれを別にすれば食べられるか、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小麦アレルギーを伝えたれ別添えで対応できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a wheat allergy. I'd like to check whether I can eat this dish if the sauce is served separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention your wheat allergy and ask whether serving the sauce separately would work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: たれ以外の材料や仕込みにも関わるため、別添えだけで判断することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ingredients other than the sauce and the preparation are involved too, so we can't judge just by serving it separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 焼く前に漬け込んでいるものがあるなら、その材料も調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 漬け込みがある場合は焼く前の材料も調べてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: If anything is marinated before grilling, could you check those ingredients too?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the ingredients used before grilling to be checked if there is any marinating. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認します。使う器具がほかの料理と共通かも確認が必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check. We also need to check whether the utensils are shared with other dishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 器具のこともお願いします。わからない部分があれば、そのまま教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 共用器具を含め不明な部分もそのまま伝えてほしいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please check the utensils too. If anything remains unknown, please tell me that as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to be told about unknown points as they are, including shared utensils. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は仕込みの材料に未確認の点があります。安全に食べられるとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are currently unchecked points about the preparation ingredients. We can't say it's safe for you to eat.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では今回は頼みません。たれだけ変えればよいと思っていたので、確認できてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確認材料があるため注文を見送りたれだけの変更では判断できないと理解を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't order it this time. I thought changing just the sauce would be enough, so I'm glad we checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decline to order because ingredients remain unconfirmed and show that changing only the sauce isn't enough to judge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 無理に注文する必要はありません。ご希望を伺ったうえで確認できる内容をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: You don't need to force yourself to order. We'll listen to your preferences and tell you what we can verify.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同行者と別の食事を相談します。材料を確かめてくださってありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認に感謝し同行者と別の食事を考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll discuss a different meal with my companion. Thank you for checking the ingredients.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Thank the staff for checking and say you will consider another meal with your companion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお連れ様とご相談ください。お食事の予定が整いましたら、気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please discuss it with your companion. Once your meal plans are settled, take care on your way out.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計前に、ご注文の変更分も確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before payment, we'll also check the changes to your order.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 売り切れだった料理を別のものに替えましたが、伝票に両方の名前が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 売切れ品を別料理にしたが両方の名前が載ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I replaced a sold-out dish with something else, but both names are on the bill.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you replaced a sold-out item with another dish but both names appear on the bill. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の料理の行には取消の表示があります。合計に含まれるか一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: The original dish's line has a cancellation mark. Let's check together whether it's included in the total.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい印が取消なんですね。二つ分払うのかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小さい印が取消で二重払いではないとわかったことを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: So that little mark means canceled. I thought I'd be paying for two dishes.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you now understand the small mark means cancellation and you aren't paying twice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更後の料理はこちらの行です。お飲み物の数も合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: The replacement dish is on this line. Is the number of drinks right too?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 飲み物は二つで合っています。友人が先に席を立ったので、私がまとめて払いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲料二つを確認し先に離席した友人の分もまとめて払いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two drinks is correct. My friend left the table first, so I'd like to pay for both of us together.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm two drinks and say you want to pay together, including for your friend who left the table first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お支払い方法を確認します。控えには変更の内容も残したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the payment method. Would you like the changes kept on your receipt too?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あとで友人に見せたいので、料理名と取消がわかる控えをもらえるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人に示すため料理名と取消がわかる控えの可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to show it to my friend later, so I'd like to ask whether I can get a receipt showing the dish names and cancellation clearly.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can get a receipt that shows the dish names and cancellation to show your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どの形式でお渡しできるか担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask the person in charge what format we can provide.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 内容がわかるものを受け取ってから、友人と金額を分けます。まずはまとめ払いの方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えを受けてから友人と分担しまずまとめ払い方法を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once I receive something showing the details, I'll split the amount with my friend. First, please tell me how to pay for everything together.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will share the cost with your friend after getting the receipt and first check how to pay together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を確認して会計をご案内します。注文の変更も確かめていただきありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll confirm your preferences and guide you through payment. Thank you for checking the order changes too. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 参拝はお済みですか。御朱印の受付についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished paying your respects? Are you asking about reception for calligraphy seals?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 参拝は済みました。御朱印帳をお願いしたあと、どこで待つのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 参拝済みで御朱印依頼後に待つ場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've finished paying my respects. I'd like to know where to wait after handing in my seal book for an inscription.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have finished paying your respects and ask where to wait after requesting a seal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申込みと受け取りの案内を、受付の担当者に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's ask the reception staff about applying and collecting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付に並ぶ人と、受け取る人の列は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申込者と受取者が同じ列か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: Are the people applying and the people collecting in the same queue?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether applicants and people collecting use the same queue. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この学習用の案内では二つの流れを分けています。実際の受付では表示に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: In these instructions for learning, the two flows are separate. At an actual reception desk, please follow the signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帳面を渡したら、受け取りの案内を聞いてから列を離れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帳面を渡し受取説明を聞いてから列を離れると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: After handing over the book, I'll listen to the collection instructions before leaving the queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will hand over the book, hear the collection explanation, then leave the queue. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取時の確認方法も、担当者の説明をよくお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also listen carefully to the staff's explanation of how they verify collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前を呼ばれるのか番号なのか、聞き取れなければその場で聞き返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名前か番号かを聞き取れなければ即座に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I can't catch whether it's by name or number, I'll ask again right there.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that if you don't catch whether it's by name or number, you will check immediately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わからないまま離れず確認することが大切ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's important to check rather than leave without understanding.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同行者には、受付の案内が終わるまで先に行かないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付案内が済むまで同行者に先へ進まないよう伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my companion not to go ahead until the reception explanation is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your companion not to go ahead until the reception instructions are finished. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 周りの方の通行を妨げず、案内に沿ってお進みください。境内で穏やかな時間をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed according to the instructions without blocking other people's way. Have a peaceful time in the temple or shrine grounds.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 説明板の図で気になる箇所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there a part of the illustration on the information board you're wondering about?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この大きな建物を見に来たのですが、今もここにあるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図の大きな建物が現在も現地にあるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came to see this large building. Is it still here now?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the large building in the illustration still exists at the site today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用の説明板では、図と現地の姿を区別して読む必要があります。図の見出しをご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this information board for learning, you need to distinguish the illustration from the site's actual appearance. Please look at the illustration's heading.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「復元」と書いてありますね。今の建物の写真だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 復元の見出しを見て現在の写真と思った誤解を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says “Reconstruction.” I thought it was a photograph of the current building.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice the reconstruction heading and explain that you mistakenly thought it was a current photograph. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 推定した姿を示す図と、現地で見られるものを分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's separately check the illustration of its estimated appearance and what you can see at the site.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 現地の石垣を先に見たいです。説明板を撮るときのルールも確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 石垣を先に見たく説明板の撮影ルールも聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to see the stone walls at the site first. Could I also check the rules for photographing the information board?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to see the stone walls first and ask about photographing the information board. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影については、その場の表示や案内で確認してください。ほかの方の見学も妨げないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: For photography, please check the signs or guidance at the location. Let's also avoid disturbing other visitors.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 人が説明を読んでいる間は待ちます。図だけでなく見出しも記録したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 読んでいる人を待ち図の見出しも記録したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait while people are reading the explanation. I'd like to record the heading as well as the illustration.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for readers and want to record the illustration's heading too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見出しを残せば、あとで現地写真と区別しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keeping the heading makes it easier to distinguish it from site photographs later.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 復元図と石垣の写真を別に整理します。見学は表示に沿って、足元を確かめながら進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 復元図と現地写真を分け表示と足元を確認して見学すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll organize the reconstruction illustration and stone-wall photos separately. I'll follow the signs while visiting and watch my footing as I go.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate reconstruction illustrations and site photos and check the signs and your footing while visiting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 説明の違いを確認できましたね。実際の案内表示を見ながら、城跡の見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've confirmed the difference in the explanation. Enjoy the castle ruins while checking the actual guidance signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の経路を図で確認なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check your walking route on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最初は長く歩くつもりでしたが、友人が少し疲れています。短く戻れる歩き方を考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者が疲れたため長い散歩から短く戻る計画へ変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: At first, I planned a long walk, but my friend is a little tired. I'd like to think of a shorter way to get back.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to change from a long walk to a shorter return plan because your companion is tired. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今いる場所を確認して、引き返す目安をお二人で決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check where you are now, and the two of you can decide when to turn back.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この先まで行くと一周しないと戻れませんか。それとも同じ道を戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一周する必要があるか同じ道を戻れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: If we go farther ahead, do we have to make a full circuit to return? Or can we return along the same path?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether a full circuit is necessary or you can return along the same path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現地の通行表示も必要です。この図だけで使える道を断定せず、表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need the site's access signs too. Don't decide which paths can be used from this map alone; check the signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 空も暗くなってきたので、遠くまで行かず休憩のあとで戻ろうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空が暗くなったため遠くへ行かず休憩後に帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: The sky is getting dark too, so I think we'll avoid going far and return after a rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that because the sky has darkened, you won't go far and will return after resting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 雨の状況に応じて無理なく判断してください。友人の方に戻る希望は聞きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Judge without overdoing it according to the rain conditions. Have you asked your friend whether they'd like to return?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 聞きました。今いるところで少し休んで、入口へ戻りたいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人は今の場所で休み入口へ戻りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have. They'd like to rest a little where we are now and go back to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that your friend wants to rest where you are and return to the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでは、休憩できる場所の表示と戻る方向を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let's check the signs for a place to rest and the direction back.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示を見て邪魔にならないところで休み、友人の歩く速さで入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩表示を確かめ友人の速さに合わせ入口へ戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll check the signs, rest somewhere we won't be in the way, and return to the entrance at my friend's walking pace.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the rest-area signs and return to the entrance at your friend's pace. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 足元が滑りやすくなっていないかもご確認ください。お二人で無理をせず、気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please also check whether the ground has become slippery. Neither of you should overdo it; take care on your way back.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お飲み物は店内でお召し上がりになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be having your drinks here?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二つとも持ち帰りです。自分の分だけ、この容器を使えるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二杯を持ち帰り自分の分だけ持参容器を使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: Both are to take away. I'd like to ask whether I can use this container just for my own drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say both drinks are to take away and ask whether you can use your own container for yours only. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持参容器の使用については、この学習店舗の担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person in charge of the shop in this learning exercise will check the use of personal containers.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 使えない場合は店の容器で構いません。先に使えるか確認してから頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参容器不可なら店舗容器でよく可否確認後に注文すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: If it can't be used, the shop's container is fine. I'll order after checking whether mine can be used first.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the shop's container is fine if yours isn't allowed and that you will order after checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 飲み物の希望も伺っておきましょう。二つは同じものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's also ask what drinks you'd like. Are both the same?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一つは温かいもの、友人の分は冷たいものにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分は温かい飲み物で友人は冷たいものを希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like one hot drink, and a cold one for my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want a hot drink for yourself and a cold one for your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 容器の対応が確認できたら注文を確定します。受け取りの呼び方はどのようになさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll finalize the order once the container arrangements are confirmed. How would you like to be called for collection?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の名前で二つまとめて受け取れますか。友人は外で待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外で待つ友人の分も自分の名前で一括受取できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: Can I collect both together under my name? My friend is waiting outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can collect both under your name, including your friend's drink while they wait outside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取方法を担当者に確認します。どちらがご自分の分か、注文の際にもう一度お伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask the person in charge about collection. When ordering, please tell us again which one is yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 容器が使えるか聞き、温かいほうが自分用だと伝えて二つまとめて受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器可否を確認し温かい杯が自分用で一括受取すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check whether I can use the container, say the hot one is mine, and collect both together.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check container use, identify the hot drink as yours, and collect both together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を整理して注文担当へ引き継ぎます。受取時にも内容をご確認いただき、持ち運びにお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll organize your preferences and pass them to the order staff. Please check the contents when collecting them too, and take care carrying them.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご来館前に、どのような情報を確認なさりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: What information would you like to check before visiting?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父と行く予定です。父は音声を聞き取りにくいので、説明を文字でも見られるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音声が聞き取りづらい父のため文字説明の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to come with my father. He has difficulty hearing audio, so I'd like to ask whether the explanations are also available in writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether written explanations are available for your father, who has trouble hearing audio. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用できる案内方法は担当窓口へ確認しましょう。どの説明をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the available guidance methods with the responsible desk. Which explanations would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 生き物についての説明です。特定の催しに参加するかは、まだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 生き物の解説を希望し催し参加は未定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: Explanations about living creatures. We haven't yet decided whether to attend a particular event.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want information about living creatures and haven't decided about attending an event. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 展示の案内と催しの案内を分けて問い合わせると整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: Separating exhibit information from event information when asking will make it easier to organize.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 文字情報の有無を先に聞きたいです。訪問予定日の開館情報も同じところで確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 文字情報を先に確認し訪問日の開館情報も同窓口で聞けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to ask about written information first. Can I also check the opening information for our planned visit date with the same desk?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about written information first and whether the same desk can check opening information for your visit date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最新の開館案内と相談窓口の確認方法をご案内します。対応内容は確認後に判断してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain how to check the latest opening information and the consultation desk. Please decide about the available support after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父には必ず文字で見られるとはまだ言わず、確認してから説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 文字対応を保証せず確認後に父へ伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't tell my father yet that he will definitely be able to read it. I'll explain after confirming.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you won't guarantee written support and will tell your father after checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確定した案内と未確認の希望を分けて伝えるということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you'll distinguish confirmed information from requests that haven't been checked yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 窓口の返事を待ち、父が利用しやすい内容を相談して訪問日を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返答後に父の利用しやすさを相談して訪問日を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait for the desk's reply, discuss what would be easy for my father to use, and decide our visit date.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss your father's ease of use after the reply and choose a visit date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お父様のご希望を整理してお問い合わせください。ご確認が済みましたら、ご家族での見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please organize your father's preferences when you inquire. Once you've checked, enjoy the visit with your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 浴室へ進む前に、お荷物の確認はお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you checked your belongings before going to the bathing area?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 着替えを入れた手提げを持っています。このまま浴室に入ってよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 着替え入りの手提げをそのまま浴室に持ち込めるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a tote bag containing a change of clothes. May I take it into the bathing area as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can take your tote with a change of clothes straight into the bathing area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習施設では、衣類と浴室で使うものを分けていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: At the facility in this learning exercise, we ask you to separate clothing from the things used in the bathing area.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 着替えは置いて、使うタオルだけ出せばいいんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 衣類を置き使用するタオルだけ出す理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should leave the change of clothes and take out only the towel I'll use, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm your understanding that you should leave the clothes and take out only the towel you will use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保管場所と鍵の管理方法も、こちらの案内で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's also check these instructions for the storage place and how to manage the key.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鍵をどこに付けるか迷っています。案内の絵を指して説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵を付ける場所を案内の絵で説明してもらうよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm unsure where to attach the key. Could you point to the picture in the instructions and explain?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of where to attach the key using the instruction picture. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この絵の付け方を確認してください。実際の鍵の形と合うかも見ておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check how it's attached in this picture. Let's also see whether it matches the shape of the actual key.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 絵と同じ形でした。なくさないよう付けてから、浴室へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 図と実物の形を照合し落とさないよう付けてから進むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was the same shape as in the picture. I'll attach it so I don't lose it before going into the bathing area.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the illustration and actual shape, and say you will attach it securely before going in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 持ち物の確認ができましたね。利用ルールで読めないところはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: You've checked your belongings. Is there anything in the rules you can't read?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この表示も読んでから入ります。わからない言葉があれば、入る前に質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を読んで不明な言葉は入室前に質問すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll read this notice too before entering. If there are words I don't understand, I'll ask before going in.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will read the notice and ask about unclear words before entering. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 荷物と鍵を整えてから、ゆっくりお進みください。足元に気をつけて、ごゆっくりおくつろぎください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Get your belongings and key ready, then take your time going in. Watch your footing and enjoy relaxing.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のプランを一緒に確認いたしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall we check your booked plan together?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が予約してくれました。朝食も付いていると思うのですが、画面のどこを見ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族名義の予約を朝食付きと思い画面の確認欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family made the booking for me. I think breakfast is included too; where should I look on the screen?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you think a booking in your family's name includes breakfast and ask where to check on the screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: プランの詳細にある食事の欄を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the meal section in the plan details.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここには食事なしと書いてありますね。家族の話を聞き違えたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食事なし表示を見て家族の説明を聞き違えた可能性を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says “No meals” here. I may have misunderstood what my family told me.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice the no-meals label and say you may have misheard your family's explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず現在の予約内容を確認しましょう。追加の食事については別に相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the current reservation details first. You can discuss additional meals separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 追加できるかと、その条件を聞いてから、家族に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加可否と条件を聞いてから家族に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to ask whether they can be added and about the conditions, then discuss it with my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to ask about whether meals can be added and the conditions before consulting your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対応と条件を確認します。今すぐ追加を決める必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the arrangements and conditions. You don't need to decide to add them right now.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。宿泊人数は二人で合っています。朝食の追加については未確認と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 人数二人は合い朝食追加の条件は未確認として家族に伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. The number of guests is correctly listed as two. I'll say that adding breakfast hasn't been checked yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that two guests is correct and you will tell your family that breakfast-addition conditions remain unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 人数と食事を分けて伝えるのですね。追加をご希望になった場合の連絡方法も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you'll explain the guest count and meals separately. Let's also check how to contact us if you decide to add breakfast.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 方法をメモして、家族の返事を聞いてから申し込みを考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡方法を記録し家族の返答後に追加を検討すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the method and consider applying after hearing my family's reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record how to contact the staff and consider adding breakfast after your family's answer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約内容の確認はできましたね。ご家族と相談なさったうえでお声がけください。どうぞゆっくりお過ごしくださいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed the reservation details. Please let us know after discussing with your family. Enjoy your stay.
